description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this well presented two bedroom ground floor apartment on Osborne Road. Situated in the heart of Jesmond and ideally situated for easy access to West Jesmond Metro Station, an array of shops, supermarkets, cafes and Independent shops on Acorn Road, library and swimming baths/gym on St Georges Terrace with further bars, upmarket restaurants and Waitrose on Osborne Road .The apartment briefly comprises; A communal front entrance with private flat entrance, well proportioned living room with period features, two generous double bedrooms, bathroom, kitchen and private south facing rear yard. There is also permit parking available.
